name: Grafana IRM
summary: Grafana IRM is free for up to 3 active users a month. The self-serve Pro tier costs $20 per active IRM user plus a $19 monthly platform fee, and Enterprise has a $25,000 a year minimum commitment.

facts.text: Grafana's documentation says alerts are grouped and routed through escalation steps that the team defines.
The documentation describes a post-incident review stage and an incident timeline, and does not describe a postmortem template.
Pro includes 3 active IRM users in the $19 monthly platform fee, with pay-as-you-go pricing beyond that and automatic volume discounts.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 active IRM users a month, community support

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: The $19 platform fee includes 3 active IRM users and 8x5 email support

hiddenCosts: Pro bills by active IRM user in a month, so the total varies with how many people respond.
